changeDiscovery: Change the text and the token pieces or token count may change.
notQwenValues: Simplified teaching example — not Qwen values
tokenKindsLabel: Tokens can be different kinds of text pieces
idLabel: The tokenizer gives it an ID label
idOnlyLabel: An ID is only a lookup label—not a score or meaning.
lookupRow: The label locates one learned number row
numbersBoundaryTitle: What is real, and what is the teaching picture?
embeddingExplanation: The model stores these learned numerical representations in its model weights. A complete representation has many values working together; one value usually has no simple meaning by itself.

summary.lookup: Each token gets an ID lookup label
